definitions.documentation: Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. definitions.description: monday.com Get Typed Column Values
definitions.documentation: Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. definitions.name: monday.com Get Item Updates
definitions.description: monday.com Get Item Updates
definitions.documentation: Fixed GraphQL query at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers. definitions.documentation: Fixed GraphQL mutation at https://api.monday.com/v2 with API-Version 2026-10. One bounded request, explicit caller pagination, no retries or redirects. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="MONDAY ADD-USERS-TO-BOARD"; mutation outcomes can be uncertain after dispatch. JSON column variables are serialized JSON text, GraphQL IDs remain strings, people/dropdown numeric identifiers must be safe integers.
